nodes.description: Owner address variable; privileged control of the token contract.
Public mapping storing token balances; mutated in transferFrom, _mints, batchSend and constructor.
Nested public mapping storing spend allowances; mutated in approve and read in transferFrom.
Whitelist mapping toggled by _mints and read by ensure.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and checked in condition.
Minimum sale amount set by init and checked in condition.
Maximum sale amount set by init and checked in condition.
Maximum number of sales per address set by init and checked in condition.
Trusted trade address set by setTradeAddress and exempted in ensure.
Total token supply assigned in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
Internal view gatekeeping routine; allows owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale senders and otherwise enforces condition.
Public payable transferFrom that mutates balances, allowance and sale counter with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve that overwrites the caller allowance.
Internal view enforcing sale count, minimum and maximum sale thresholds.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-controllable address with arbitrary calldata.
Privileged mint function that overwrites balances and enables the canSale whitelist.
Owner-only initialization of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer that computes total with unchecked multiplication and distributes balances in a loop.
Owner-only setter of the trusted tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation using CREATE2 hashing.
Payable constructor that sets metadata, owner, initial supply and an unlimited allowance to UNI.
msg.sender; used for authorization checks and as the transfer source.
Low-level delegatecall executed on an arbitrary, externally supplied address.
Unchecked multiplication and balance arithmetic inside batchSend under Solidity 0.5.x.
Unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic inside transferFrom.
Token amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom.
Source address parameter of ensure/transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of ensure/transferFrom.
Mint amount parameter of _mints.
Sale count parameter of init.
Array of destination addresses in batchSend.
Delegatecall target address parameter of delegate.
Delegatecall calldata parameter of delegate.
Local variable total computed in batchSend.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the transfer source when transfer forwards to transferFrom.
msg.sender determines whether the allowance path is taken and is used as spender.
msg.sender is written as the allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender must equal owner to reach the arbitrary delegatecall.
msg.sender is checked against owner and a hardcoded privileged address in _mints.
msg.sender must equal owner to initialize sale parameters.
msg.sender must equal owner to execute batchSend.
msg.sender must equal owner to change the trade address.
msg.sender becomes the owner and initial balance in the constructor.
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom.
transferFrom requires the ensure gate to pass before moving balances.
ensure calls condition for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure computes the Uniswap pair address via pairFor.
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction and addition on balances and allowance.
batchSend performs unchecked multiplication and subtraction of the caller balance.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall controlled by the target parameter.
The arbitrary delegatecall executes external code in the contract context and can re-enter state-changing functions.
The _value parameter flows directly into unchecked balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
The _value parameter is multiplied by the recipient count in batchSend without overflow checks.
_tos.length is used as a multiplier in the unchecked total computation.
The local total derived from _value and _tos.length is subtracted from balanceOf.
The target address parameter flows into the delegatecall destination.
The calldata parameter flows into the delegatecall payload.
_from is evaluated against the whitelist in ensure.
_to is evaluated against the whitelist in ensure.
_from indexes the per-address sale counter in condition.
saleNum is stored into the _saleNum state variable during init.
addedValue is used to compute the overwritten balance in _mints.
addedValue multiplied by decimals is assigned to balanceOf[spender].
ensure reads the canSale whitelist for the source address.
ensure compares _from and _to against owner.
ensure compares the source address against tradeAddress.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for source and destination.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments the _onSaleNum counter of the source.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the sale limit.
condition compares _value to _minSale.
condition compares _value to _maxSale.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] to _saleNum.
_mints sets canSale[spender] to true.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender].
init assigns the _minSale state variable.
init assigns the _maxSale state variable.
init assigns the _saleNum state variable.
batchSend debits the caller balance and credits each recipient.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
The constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the supply.
The constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the UNI router address.
The constructor sets the totalSupply state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: _value is a transfer amount parameter that only affects the arithmetic and balance updates inside transferFrom.
_from is the source parameter consumed by ensure and the balance mutation in transferFrom.
_to is the destination parameter consumed by ensure and the balance mutation in transferFrom.
addedValue is only used to compute the minted balance inside _mints.
saleNum is only used to set the _saleNum state variable inside init.
_tos is only iterated over inside batchSend to credit recipients.
The target address a is only consumed by the delegatecall in delegate.
The calldata b is only consumed by the delegatecall in delegate.
The local total is only produced by the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
